content_metadata.description: Tyler announces an upcoming interview with Bishop James Long, discussing paranormal encounters, demons, ghosts, and exorcisms.

qAndA.answer: The interview will take place on Saturday at 3:00 PM Eastern Time.
qAndA.question: When will the interview with Bishop James Long take place?

qAndA.answer: The interview will be broadcasted on YouTube and Facebook.
qAndA.question: Where can viewers watch the interview?

qAndA.answer: The interview will cover topics such as paranormal encounters, demons, ghosts, exorcisms, and more.
qAndA.question: What topics will be discussed during the interview?

qAndA.answer: Bishop James Long is a practicing exorcist, paranormal investigator, author of 'Through the Eyes of an Exorcist,' and host of The Sacred Division podcast. He has also appeared on Ghost Adventures with Zak Bagans.
qAndA.question: Why is Bishop James Long qualified to speak on these topics?

qAndA.answer: Yes, there will be an audience Q&A session during the interview.
qAndA.question: Will there be an opportunity for viewers to interact during the interview?

youtube_description:
Join David Russell (PorA) and myself as we talk ghosts, demons, exorcisms and paranormal encounters with Roman Catholic Exorcist Bishop James Long! 

Link to interview here:
https://youtu.be/QqIwCoxL8wA

Bishop James Long also has authored a book entitled "Through the Eyes of an Exorcist", hosts the podcast "The Sacred Division" and has appeared on TV shows like Ghost Adventures with Zak Bagans and Aaron Goodwin!
